description: The DECOMPOSED spelling of the same name — 'cafe', U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT, '.json' — kept in its own fixture because a normalization-insensitive filesystem would collide the two spellings inside one directory. CORRECTED 2026-09-11: this fixture was NOT decomposed. Its key was byte-identical to its -precomposed twin (636166c3a92e6a736f6e, 9 codepoints, precomposed U+00E9), so the two cases were the same test twice and the NFC/NFD axis was entirely unexercised — there were ZERO occurrences of U+0301 anywhere in the corpus. The key is now 63616665cc812e6a736f6e, 10 codepoints. Measured before correcting: this filesystem preserves the written bytes rather than normalizing them, so the spelling that is authored is the spelling the loader sees.
